title: Rockmoon Financial Data
description: Cross-market (US/JP/KR) structured financials, segments, ownership & metrics, traceable to filings.
summary: Cross-market (US/JP/KR) structured financials, segments, ownership & metrics, traceable to filings.
offersHint: Cross-market (US/JP/KR) structured financials, segments, ownership & metrics, traceable to filings. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.rockmoon.ai/mcp · Requires headers: X-API-Key

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Rockmoon API key (get one at https://rockmoon.ai)

headerDocs.name: X-API-Key
headerDocs.description: Rockmoon API key (get one at https://rockmoon.ai)

toolsPreview.name: search_companies
toolsPreview.description: Search companies by ticker or name across US/JP/KR/HK/CN/UK.

toolsPreview.name: get_company
toolsPreview.description: Get company facts (name, exchange, industry, regulator id, filings url).

toolsPreview.name: get_financials
toolsPreview.description: Get all three financial statements (IS + BS + CF) for a ticker.

toolsPreview.name: get_income_statement
toolsPreview.description: Get income statement (revenue, costs, margins, EPS).

toolsPreview.name: get_cash_flow
toolsPreview.description: Get cash flow statement (OCF, ICF, FCF, capex, dividends).

toolsPreview.name: get_filing_source
toolsPreview.description: Get the original SEC filing URL for a fiscal quarter or year from Rockmoon's stored provenance; use this instead of web search.

toolsPreview.name: get_prices
toolsPreview.description: Get daily price history for a ticker.

toolsPreview.name: get_segments
toolsPreview.description: Get reported business / geographic / product segments.

toolsPreview.name: get_segments_trend
toolsPreview.description: Get time-series of segment values across periods for trend analysis.

toolsPreview.name: get_director_holdings
toolsPreview.description: Get director / officer shareholdings (insider equity stakes).

toolsPreview.name: get_insider_trades
toolsPreview.description: Get insider trading activity (US Form 4 filings).

toolsPreview.name: get_metrics
toolsPreview.description: Get latest valuation + financial metrics snapshot (PE, PB, ROE etc.).

toolsPreview.name: screen_companies
toolsPreview.description: Screen stocks across US/JP/KR/HK/CN by valuation + quality metrics (PE, PB, ROE, margins, market cap, dividend yield).

toolsPreview.name: get_metrics_history
toolsPreview.description: Get historical derived metrics (TTM aggregates + margins per period).

toolsPreview.name: compare_metrics
toolsPreview.description: Compare valuation metrics across multiple tickers.
